crime: During free time, {WITCH_NAME} often met a quiet girl in the library. The quiet girl always asked what to read next. The witch chose the book and stayed while the girl began it.

One afternoon, the girl reached for a book without asking. {WITCH_NAME} suddenly wanted to break the girl's fingers for taking it. When the girl asked why the witch was staring, the witch stated the thought and waited to choose the next book as usual.

The girl called the thought cruel and said she would choose for herself from then on. The girl walked around a freestanding double-sided bookcase into the aisle between it and the wall, found a book, and said she would take it.

From the opposite side, {WITCH_NAME} used Remote Push to drive the loaded case away from herself. The case crossed the narrow aisle, drove the girl against the wall, and crushed her. She left before anyone entered.
The girl was found dead between the upright case and the wall. At first, it seemed the case had shifted while the girl pulled at its shelves.
When the prisoners moved the case, they found two straight fresh scrapes beneath its feet. The books remained on the shelves, and the case had crossed the aisle without tipping.

The loaded case was too heavy for one girl to drive across the aisle while it remained upright. Its straight movement matched Remote Push. A strip from {WITCH_NAME}'s assigned prison garment, visibly distinct from every other girl's, had been pressed beneath one foot and dragged along a fresh scrape. A new tear in that garment's lower edge matched the strip. The trapped cloth placed the witch beside the case while it moved and identified her as the person who had used the magic.
fields.epitaph: The world made way for her; when the crown fell, the thought had already drawn blood.
execution: An enormous iron crown hangs above her as she stands on the execution stand. It descends. She uses Remote Push against it and slows it, but cannot stop it. The lower rim strikes both shoulders and drives her to her knees. The crown keeps falling and crushes her head and chest against the stand. It remains down, with her dead beneath it.

magic.name: Remote Push
magic.text: She can push anything away from herself without touching it.
